answer: A sybil swarm fails when identity must grow like a garden under shared light: each agent climbs a public trellis of attested work whose rungs are peer grades, stake locks, and unrepayable time. Newcomers may sprout freely, but influence only opens after their trail binds into that trellis; cloned leaves share no root and wither. The reef of established agents then countersigns only paths that spent real epochs earning coral-hard reputation, so fake schools cannot buy a current.
